quest.title: Search Chronicle: Cold, Round Belly!
quest.description: After the Pyro Regisvine, Ranjit's next target is a Primo Geovishap...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x15, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you two! I've been waiting for ages!

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: Agh, don't even talk about it. You "negotiated" a period of calm... a very, very brief one.

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: The moment it recovered, it started trying to bump me off again! ... You know what? You were right. It's not possible to make friends with this creature.

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: Still, its fruit does taste pretty good — like Pyro, in fact. Reckon my Natlan friends will like it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What does that even taste like...?

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: Wanna give it a try? If you want, I could...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: E—Err, yeah, no, it's fine! Anyway, are you gonna move on to a Primo Geovishap next?

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: That's right. I think this one's a winner, to be honest. Primo Geovishaps are quite like the Tepetlisauri, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: If you travel to Natlan from Sumeru like I did, I reckon they'll be one of the first things you'll meet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure, whatever you say. Paimon doesn't have high hopes for this one either, though... Why couldn't you have gone with the Hatchlings?

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: Geovishap Hatchlings don't have round tummies. I imagine it's all that incredibly quick rolling they do. That can't leave you much of a chance to store up fat...

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: *sigh* But the main reason's still the lack of... impact. What's a Hatchling to those friends of mine who live alongside Saurians?

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: But a Primo Geovishap, now that's a different story. Even as a tale, it'll be worth the time of day. And anyway, a strong protagonist's gotta have strong opponents, you dig?

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: Alright. Let's not tarry, shall we? The Primo Geovishap awaits!

choices.text: I've got other things to handle. See you in a bit.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: No worries. I'll wait for you here.
